manually edited result without raw evidence
executionRules.resultRule: A result exists only when the declared evidence fields are captured from the named stage and bound to an immutable commit or release candidate.

localModule.claim: Track 6A can validate only artifact integrity, closed dictionaries, hashes, evidence shapes and fail-closed draft states on this machine.

fixedRcOrServer.claim: These controls require a fixed release candidate, browser/runtime evidence, an isolated server or cloud environment, or a destructive recovery exercise; Track 6A has not executed them.

humanApproval.claim: A local validator cannot supply legal, privacy, trust-and-safety, license, on-call or customer-copy approval.

controls.positive: A same-origin /open/{publicCampaignId} URL has no query, fragment or tracking, qrPayload is byte-equal to it, and QR rendering performs no network or analytics request.
controls.negative: Possession of publicCampaignId alone cannot read viewer data, create a batch, supply an ordinal, or call upload APIs.

controls.positive: Same-origin Origin, Host and Fetch-Metadata checks issue only the fixed __Host-unseen_campaign_challenge Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict Path=/ cookie and no business authority.
controls.negative: Cross-origin, wrong Host, missing same-origin Fetch-Metadata, altered nonce, or challenge for another campaign returns the uniform campaign response and creates no grant.

controls.positive: Live campaign, challenge, Space state, cap, pending, rate and abuse checks atomically create one per-visitor grant and increment pending once.
controls.negative: Missing, paused, revoked, expired, exhausted, rate-limited, abuse-blocked, cap-reached and wrong-task states have the same stable code, status/body class and equivalent latency without revealing remaining capacity.

controls.positive: The earliest same-origin bootstrap reads only #invite or #receipt into memory, synchronously calls history.replaceState, then permits the family-matched POST exchange under no-store, no-referrer and strict CSP.
controls.negative: Before clearing, any subresource, favicon, service worker, third party, API call, prefetch, DOM/storage/history persistence, error capture or analytics observation fails the test.

controls.positive: One atomic exchange consumes a grant, assigns one non-reused campaign ordinal, decrements pending, increments successful use and creates isolated sessions whose access expiry does not exceed campaign expiry.
controls.negative: A concurrent loser, refresh, forwarded fragment, wrong family, expired bootstrap or different idempotency key cannot consume again; a successful session remains usable after bootstrap expiry but fails on access expiry or campaign revoke/expiry.

controls.positive: B and D entering the same combo campaign obtain distinct challenge, grant, ordinal, principal and session chains while C has an independent view-only chain.
controls.negative: B, C and D cannot read or mutate another visitor's batch, receipt, photo, principal, session or campaign-scoped resource; the view-only actor never gains upload.

controls.positive: Every protected read and mutation reloads the exact Space plus campaign, batch, item, photo and principal/session composite relationship and current versions.
controls.negative: Replacing any Space, batch, item, photo, campaign, grant, principal or session ID with a cross-Space or sibling actor value fails closed with no state change and no object existence leak.

controls.positive: Bounded at-least-once sweeping expires each challenge, abandoned grant or campaign once and appends the frozen terminal audit events in the same transaction.
controls.negative: Re-running a cutoff changes nothing; an exchange/sweeper race decrements pending once; pending=0 or audit append failure rolls back and alerts instead of clamping or losing evidence.

controls.positive: Account, viewer, contributor, receipt and case sessions use Secure HttpOnly SameSite cookies, rotation/revoke and the declared CSRF, Origin and Host checks.
controls.negative: Missing or invalid CSRF, cross-origin submission, wrong Host, fixed session reuse after rotation, or use of a credential response from cache cannot mutate or refresh authority.

controls.positive: OTP verification binds challenge, rotation-invariant identity equivalence and purpose; concurrent first verification creates exactly one Account and stores the current session epoch.
controls.negative: Missing account, wrong code, purpose, challenge or identity, fifth failure and expiry have non-enumerating responses and never create a second Account across key rotation.

controls.positive: Logout-all atomically increments accounts.sessionEpoch and accounts.version and revokes every family and session while a new login uses the new epoch.
controls.negative: Every old session and family fails even when an injected revocation fanout miss leaves an individual revokedAt empty; a stale epoch cannot authenticate or reauth.

controls.positive: A fresh grant bound to current account, session epoch, exact action, closed purpose and target is consumed in the sensitive mutation transaction.
controls.negative: A similar purpose, another action/target/Space/account, old epoch, ordinary session, expired/revoked grant or replay cannot authorize the mutation; receipt-item deletion never accepts an owner reauth grant.

controls.positive: Every mutable operation references only generated Version/CAS fields and increments each actually changed aggregate in the same transaction; immutable events are append-only.
controls.negative: An alias such as ownerVersion, a stale actual version, a missing multi-row comparison, or a replay that increments version is rejected by module contract tests.

controls.positive: Same scope, key and request hash follows the operation replay class only after current authorization is reloaded; a completed state does not repeat side effects.
controls.negative: Same key with a different body returns idempotency_conflict; cached Cookie, authorization or signed URL never reappears; an expired one-time envelope returns completed without recovering its value.

controls.positive: Commit reads the exact private object bytes and records observed byte count, MIME, magic and a real decoder result before an item can commit.
controls.negative: Declared MIME/extension mismatch, polyglot, path traversal, duplicate chunks, truncated HEIC, altered bytes or checksum/count mismatch fails closed and creates no visible Photo.

controls.positive: JPEG, PNG, static WebP, HEIC and HEIF pass only inside versioned byte, pixel, frame, metadata, CPU, memory and wall-time limits in an isolated decoder.
controls.negative: Animated GIF/APNG/WebP/HEIF sequence, pixel/ICC/metadata bomb, decoder crash, timeout and resource-limit exhaustion are quarantined or deleted and never silently use the first frame.

controls.positive: EXIF orientation is applied before dimension, derivative and locator work; color is normalized and only approved minimal capture information continues.
controls.negative: GPS or precise location, device serial number, unapproved metadata or pre-orientation geometry cannot enter persistence, locator input, DTO, log, derivative or export.

controls.positive: Raw, normalized derivative, thumbnail, panorama and locator input each have distinct hashes and provenance linking exact source object, policy release and processing build.
controls.negative: A derivative presented with the raw hash, a locator result for another panorama revision, or an object/DB checksum mismatch cannot activate, display or switch.

controls.positive: The exact receipt item or owner branch first removes viewer/receipt authority, revokes item and signed URLs, cancels jobs, then processes raw, derivative, thumbnail, suggestion, private output, CDN and backup disposition.
controls.negative: Reviewer-only deletion, a cross-item/cross-Space identifier, successful media read after revocation, or a delete worker that runs object removal before revocation fails the gate.

controls.positive: Owner reauth first archives/private-pauses the Space and revokes campaigns, invitations and viewer, contributor and receipt sessions with real version increments before cascading assets, jobs, cache, CDN and backup disposition through a ledger.
controls.negative: Any non-owner read, stale session, receipt recovery or business mutation after the first transaction fails closed even when an injected child-session fanout write is missing.

controls.positive: Account deletion revokes account sessions and provider identifiers first, removes Membership and receipt bindings, and applies approved audit minimization after every owned active or archived Space is transferred or deleted.
controls.negative: An undisposed owned Space returns 409 with zero partial deletion; no flow can orphan an owner or preserve usable session/binding authority.

controls.positive: Every attempt and status change appends a monotonic seq plus previousEventId link and immutable resource hash; retries are idempotent and preserve prior event bytes.
controls.negative: Updating attempts, lastError or completed state in an old event, breaking the chain, reusing a seq or reporting completion with unresolved objects/CDN fails validation.

controls.positive: Account self-export and owner Space export use async jobs and a short-lived private same-origin authorization whose participant projection is scoped to the requester and approved Space records.
controls.negative: The export cannot include another participant's identifiers or private projection, credential material, internal object keys, raw location/device metadata, hidden raw media outside approved scope, or a durable signed URL.

controls.positive: A live account, viewer or receipt branch derives the target relationship server-side, stores one exact actor branch with current version snapshots, returns a high-entropy case ID and signs independent minimal case access when required.
controls.negative: A bare/cross-Space object ID, actor fields supplied by the client, invalid relation, enumerable case ID, attachment/asset/upload session or multipart field creates no case or media and reveals no target existence.

controls.positive: An eligible same active Account, live case access or affected live receipt branch submits only the closed category and bounded statement and receives a separate appeal case status.
controls.negative: Appeal never changes photo content automatically, never restores target access, rejects unknown reason/decision/media fields, and returns a uniform unavailable response after independent case access is revoked.

controls.positive: A rate-limited generic support/security lead creates a high-entropy case with category and coarse status without requiring object access.
controls.negative: An unauthenticated support body containing targetObjectId, photoId, Space ID or related object reference is rejected or ignored and cannot become an object-report bypass.

controls.positive: Current owner or canReview membership uses content_cases.version CAS and appends an immutable decision event with exact authorization snapshot.
controls.negative: Stale case or authorization version, invalid reason combination or pure case transition cannot change Photo; only a separate valid CONTENT action may perform the photo transition.

controls.positive: Only the declared event, request, service, route template, result class, duration bucket, policy version, coarse actor kind and campaign-local aggregate fields may be emitted.
controls.negative: Any secret, raw bootstrap URL, raw IP, full user agent, risk MAC, identifier, signed URL or stable cross-campaign visitor key in log, trace, metric, analytics, DTO or crash report fails the gate.

controls.positive: Runtime-generated per-run markers are injected through each credential/error boundary and only their one-way canary IDs appear in the canary result record.
controls.negative: Discovery of any generated marker in application, CDN, WAF, analytics, trace, crash, metric, browser console/history or storage immediately blocks release and invokes the secret-redaction runbook.

controls.positive: Versioned limits combine Account, campaign, per-visitor authority, Space, batch/item, object bytes, case and short-TTL keyed network/client-risk buckets with bounded backoff.
controls.negative: Exhausting one dimension cannot reveal account/campaign/object existence, remaining quota or another campaign's visitor identity; raw network/client data and device fingerprints are never persisted.

controls.positive: Consent withdrawal, campaign lifecycle, authorization change, content decision, case decision and deletion events append immutable IDs, current version snapshots, reason classes and request IDs only.
controls.negative: An update to an old event, missing frozen event kind, owner DTO subject ID, recoverable SceneNote text, prohibited log field or absent partial-unique terminal event constraint fails the test.

redactionCanary.generation: runtime CSPRNG value assembled only in the test process and destroyed after the run
redactionCanary.successCondition: zero runtime marker occurrences in every sink

scopes.firstTransaction: remove viewer and receipt projection, revoke item and signed URLs, cancel jobs
archive, private, pause and revoke campaigns, invitations and all viewer, contributor and receipt sessions with real version increments
increment session epoch, revoke sessions and provider identifiers after owned Space disposition precondition

deletionContract.restoreRule: Replay deletion and revocation ledgers before traffic; deleted, revoked, hidden and rejected content must not revive.

exportContract.participantProjection: requester-scoped account data or owner-authorized Space data with other participant identifiers and private projections minimized or excluded
exportContract.delivery: async job plus short-lived private same-origin download authorization
exportContract.credentialReplay: re-authorize and issue a current session-bound authorization; never cache or revive an old URL
